label: Fusion and Plasma Physics
description: Plasma physics, laser-plasma interactions, fusion diagnostics, confinement, and high-energy plasma systems.
summary: Fusion and Plasma Physics is represented as a curated static OpenAlex topic profile. Aggregate queries match 16,405 works across five completed years.
